text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the racing schedule winding down, I 
used the 
Hot Springs Trip Ticket I won at the 
raffle 
to come and enjoy a restful getaway.
choice_data_list: (Or at least, that was the plan—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Wait...! 
There's a hidden hot spring around 
here...?

text_block_list.name: Inn Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Well... more like a 'too hidden' hot 
spring, I guess. 
Nobody mentions visiting it these days.

text_block_list.name: Inn Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Back in the day, people came just for 
that, 
but as time went on, it was gradually 
forgotten... 
and eventually, nature completely 
reclaimed it.

text_block_list.name: Inn Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Rumor has it, it was an incredible bath 
where you could relax out in the open 
wilderness...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: An incredible... hot spring...!
choice_data_list: Curious?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest... ever since visiting the 
'Umamusume Hot Springs' in Fukushima, I've 
fallen in love with hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that it's an incredible spring... 
makes my heart flutter a little.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's go check it out!

text_block_list.name: Inn Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I know I brought it up, but... 
it's seriously deep in the mountains, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It will be fine. Together... 
no ordinary mountain can defeat us!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
According to the map they gave us, 
it should be this way.
choice_data_list: The path is pretty flat so far.
The path is pretty flat so far.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes... at this rate, it feels like anyone 
could make the trek with ease, but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—It looks like we have to cross this river 
next.
choice_data_list:
The current is fast... We need to be 
careful.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'll support you! 
Just be careful not to 
slip on the rocks.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I see. It seems the hot spring 
is just down past here.
choice_data_list: (Wait, isn't that a sheer cliff...?!)
(Wait, isn't that a sheer cliff...?!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, people used it in the past, so 
there has to 
be a way down... With that in mind, I 
looked around... 
and spotted something behind the ivy.
choice_data_list: Look, there's a ladder over there!
Look, there's a ladder over there!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah... you're right. 
I didn't notice it at all...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. 
Well then, shall we climb down?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After checking the ladder's sturdiness, 
we descended to the base of the sheer 
cliff, 
carefully securing our footing every step 
of the way.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Tore-san! I've got you supported, 
so try taking a quick look behind you!
choice_data_list: Behind me? ...Ah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Turning around, I beheld a view... 
not just of the mountain ranges, but of 
the distant hot spring town, 
with plumes of steam rising into the air 
in a truly magical sight—
choice_data_list:
(Man... I'm doing something pretty wild 
right now.)

(Man... I'm doing something pretty wild 
right now.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
This should be the right spot, but... 
there's nothing that looks like a hot 
spring anywhere.
choice_data_list: You're right...
You're right...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, I noticed a tiny puddle. 
On a hunch, I dipped my fingertips into 
it, and...
choice_data_list: ...Ah, it's warm!
...Ah, it's warm!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Wait... then 
this is... the hidden spring?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
choice_data_list: Well, guess things like this happen.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... you're taking this 
surprisingly well.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
After all the hard work it took 
to make it out here...
choice_data_list: The journey was fun, so I don't mind.
The journey was fun, so I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, that's true.
choice_data_list: Are you okay with this, Daring Tact?
Are you okay with this, Daring Tact?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. 
I was certainly looking forward to it, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The inn has a wonderful bath waiting for 
us, and 
after moving around this much—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It's guaranteed to feel heavenly! 
—Shall we head back, then?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While bathing...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
choice_data_list: Looks like you had a relaxing soak.
Looks like you had a relaxing soak.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes... 
I was able to just zone out.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: How was it for you, Tore-san?
choice_data_list: Same here. My mind went completely blank.
Same here. My mind went completely blank.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the day's exertion, the hot 
spring soaked deeply 
into my tired body... making for the most 
relaxing time imaginable.
choice_data_list:
I also kept thinking back to that view 
from the cliff.

I also kept thinking back to that view 
from the cliff.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Me too! 
It was such a breathtaking panorama.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Back then, Tore-san, you immediately 
surveyed our surroundings 
and discovered the ladder... 
You were so dependable.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You've grown so strong and capable, 
Tore-san.
choice_data_list: ...You think so?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Um, so. Would it be alright... if I 
asked 
for one selfish favor?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It feels a bit wrong to take advantage 
of your kindness, but...
choice_data_list: Of course! Ask me anything!
Of course! Ask me anything!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Would you like to explore even more 
hidden hot springs with me?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure hot springs nestled deep within 
rugged nature 
exist all across this country... 
No, across the entire world.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Conquering steep, treacherous trails 
together... 
and enjoying the hot spring waiting at the 
end 
with the companion who worked so hard to 
get there.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
To me, that feels like 
such a vital, luxurious experience.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Will you come along with me?
choice_data_list: Of course! Let's take them on together!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! 
Hehe... Now I have even more to look 
forward to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment that made me feel 
an irreplaceable bond forming 
between Daring Tact and myself...
